godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.description: Standard competitive 10-player setup with Godfather, Matador, Saul Goodman, Doctor, Detective, Leon, Constantine, Nostradamus, and Citizens.

classic.name: Classic Mafia
classic.description: Traditional Mafia rules with Godfather, Doctor, Detective, and Citizens.

godfather.name: Godfather
godfather.description: Leader of the Mafia. Possesses an armored vest (shield against 1 night shot) and has a clean record in Detective inquiries.

matador.name: Matador
matador.description: Mafia enforcer who can block one player each night, preventing them from using their night abilities.

saul-goodman.name: Saul Goodman
saul-goodman.description: Corrupt attorney who can buy a citizen without a role into the Mafia organization under specific tournament rules.

mafia.name: Mafia
mafia.description: Simple Mafia member who coordinates night shots with the team to eliminate the town.

doctor.name: Doctor
doctor.description: Can heal one player each night (including themselves) to protect them from fatal shots.

detective.name: Detective
detective.description: Can investigate one player each night to determine if they belong to the Mafia (Godfather appears innocent).

citizen.name: Citizen
citizen.description: Regular member of the Town. Must deduce and vote out Mafia members during the Day phase.

nostradamus.name: Nostradamus
nostradamus.description: Neutral prophet. Inquires about 3 players on Night 1 to discover how many are Mafia, and chooses to side with Town or Mafia to win.

constantine.name: Constantine
constantine.description: Has the one-time power to revive an eliminated player from the dead back into the game.

leon.name: Leon (Vigilante)
leon.description: Town sniper who can eliminate suspects at night. If Leon shoots an innocent citizen, Leon dies from penalty/guilt!

mindInquiry.description: The eliminated player can guess the exact roles of up to 2 living players. If correct, special rewards or penalties apply per tournament rules.

silence.name: Silence of the Lambs
silence.description: The eliminated player picks one living player who is completely silenced and cannot speak during the next Day phase.

redemption.name: Red Carpet
redemption.description: The eliminated player designates a player who will be automatically brought to the defense stage on the next day's voting.

doubleVote.name: Final Shot
doubleVote.description: Grants the eliminated player's faction or chosen ally an additional vote power in the next voting phase.

revealedAlignment.name: Identity Reveal

beautifulMind.description: The eliminated player asks the moderator whether a specific faction holds a majority in a chosen section of the table.

mafiaShot.name: Mafia Night Shot
mafiaShot.desc: Coordinates with the Mafia team to designate 1 player for elimination.

godfatherShield.name: Armored Vest
godfatherShield.desc: Passively absorbs 1 lethal night shot without dying.

cleanInquiry.name: Clean Record
cleanInquiry.desc: Appears as an innocent Town member when investigated by the Detective.

block.name: Role Block
block.desc: Silences the target's active night ability for that night.

buy.name: Bribe Citizen
buy.desc: Under tournament rules, bribes an unassigned citizen into the mafia syndicate.

teamShot.name: Coordinated Shot
teamShot.desc: Carries out the mafia elimination shot when designated or if leader is eliminated.

treat.name: Medical Treatment
treat.desc: Prevents death if the target is shot on the same night. Self-heal allowed.

investigate.name: Identity Inquiry
investigate.desc: Investigates 1 player to reveal if they are Mafia (Godfather appears clean).

vigilanteShot.name: Town Sniper Shot
vigilanteShot.desc: Eliminates suspected Mafia. Penalty: If target is innocent Town, Leon dies from guilt at dawn and the target survives!

revive.name: Revive Soul
revive.desc: Brings 1 dead player back to life before sunrise (1 charge per game).

chooseSide.name: Prophecy & Siding
chooseSide.desc: Inquires 3 players to learn how many are Mafia, and chooses to win with Town or Mafia.

prophetShield.name: Prophet's Cloak
prophetShield.desc: Immune to deadly night shots throughout the entire game.

deduction.name: Civic Deduction & Vote
deduction.desc: Uses logical argumentation and daytime voting to eliminate hidden Mafia members.

tactics.godfather: Coordinate with Matador to block the Doctor before ordering night shots.
tactics.matador: Focus on blocking high-value targets like the Doctor or Detective early on.
tactics.saulGoodman: Keep a low profile to recruit an unassigned citizen when the time is right.
tactics.mafia: Blend in during daytime discussions and cast strategic votes with the town.
tactics.doctor: Save unexpected targets to throw off the Mafia's kill patterns. Guard your self-heal.
tactics.detective: Share verified inquiries tactfully without exposing your identity immediately.
tactics.leon: Only shoot with strong day evidence to avoid triggering the fatal guilt penalty.
tactics.constantine: Wait for a critical power role (like Doctor or Detective) to die before using your revive.
tactics.nostradamus: Choose the 3 most vocal players on Night 1 to gauge table balance.
tactics.citizen: Observe voting patterns and challenge inconsistencies during speech turns.

step1.desc: Godfather vest and Nostradamus cloak protect against incoming shots.

step2.title: Priority 90 — Role Blocks & Bribes
step2.desc: Matador cancels target's ability execution. Saul Goodman bribes target.

step3.title: Priority 80 — Doctor Save & Protection
step3.desc: Doctor treats target, preventing lethal damage for the night.

step4.title: Priority 70 — Lethal Night Shots
step4.desc: Godfather/Mafia and Leon fire deadly shots. Leon penalty evaluated.

step5.title: Priority 50 — Inquiries & Readings
step5.desc: Detective discovers target's faction. Nostradamus receives mafia count.

step6.title: Priority 10 — Constantine Revivals
step6.desc: Constantine restores a fallen player back to the living roster.

step7.title: Sunrise & Dawn Announcement
step7.desc: The moderator calculates all shields, saves, and kills to announce actual eliminations.
